summary: Домен diagrams на baseline e1c184857e46: канонические Mermaid-источники и pinned render (10.6.1), PR syntax/lint/drift для изменённых файлов. Phase-2 CI (full render, visual smoke, quality gates, nightly) отключена (#11196); regression pool 6 SVG при ~494 источниках; 24 STALE-002 и policy-doc drift. surface_score=2, P0/P1 нет.
top_remediations: Согласовать diagram-regression-test-plan и README tooling с фактическими disabled jobs в docs.yml/diagram-nightly.yml или восстановить budgeted dispatch/canary.
Регулярно запускать run_diagram_checks.sh --profile pr и расширять visual-smoke manifest по критичным семействам.
Обновить метаданные @date для architecture 24–31 (STALE-002) после верификации содержимого.
Исправить LINK-001 (semantic arrow mix) на ключевых flowchart.
Обновить Last verified в docs/02-architecture/diagrams/README.md и unpinned install hints в governance prompts.

findings.method: read docs.yml render-diagrams job condition and steps
findings.observation: Job render-diagrams is permanently skipped via if: ${{ false }}; steps include full render.sh, check_diagram_artifacts, visual smoke, and check_diagram_quality_gates.
findings.expected: PR hard gates DIAG-T009–T013/T018–T023 from diagram-regression-test-plan execute when diagram renderer inputs change.
findings.actual: Comment states full-corpus rendering intentionally disabled; only validate-mermaid, check-diagram-drift, and targeted ChEMBL render jobs remain active.
findings.impact: Committed SVG baselines and quality-gate regressions outside changed-file drift path are not re-validated on merge.
findings.root_cause: Actions billing policy #11196 disables expensive corpus render while keeping cheaper syntax/lint/drift checks.
findings.remediation: Update SSOT regression plan gate table to match CI, or add workflow_dispatch/budgeted job running run_diagram_checks.sh --profile pr on main.
findings.automation: architecture test already references workflow; extend to assert documented gate tier vs job if:

findings.method: read diagram-nightly workflow schedule and job guard
findings.observation: Diagram Nightly Regression workflow has schedule removed and nightly-phase2 job if: false.
findings.expected: Nightly DIAG-T024–T029 and extended visual smoke tiers run on a defined cadence or manual dispatch with working jobs.
findings.actual: Header KEEP-DISABLED (#11196); only workflow_dispatch remains; primary job never runs.
findings.impact: Extended/broad visual smoke, PNG compatibility nightly checks, and lint-budget enforcement do not run automatically.
findings.root_cause: Same billing disable as docs.yml render job; scripts remain for local/manual use.
findings.remediation: Document manual runbook (run_diagram_nightly_suite.py / run_diagram_checks.sh --profile nightly) or re-enable dispatch-only job without schedule.

findings.method: count manifest entries vs lint corpus; run check-artifacts default manifest
findings.observation: visual-smoke.txt lists 6 SVG paths; lint corpus has 493 diagram source files and 493 tracked SVG under docs/02-architecture/diagrams.
findings.expected: PR regression pool sized to critical architecture families or full corpus render gated when sources change.
findings.actual: check-artifacts default validates 6 entries only; quality-gates.txt has 5 stems; extended tier 26 entries still tied to disabled nightly job.
findings.impact: Visual/artifact regressions on diagrams outside the 6-entry pool can merge if source files were not touched in the PR.
findings.root_cause: Cost control shrinks automated pool; drift gate covers only edited sources.
findings.remediation: Expand visual-smoke manifest incrementally (priority families) or require periodic full run_diagram_checks on main via dispatch.
findings.automation: CI job when re-enabled; local run_diagram_checks.sh

findings.method: compare regression plan gate column vs active docs.yml jobs
findings.observation: Plan marks DIAG-T013 visual smoke and DIAG-T018 link-style gates as Hard on PR; active PR path only runs validate_mermaid_syntax.sh and lint_diagrams.py plus optional drift check.
findings.expected: Documented Hard PR gates have an executing CI step or are downgraded to Soft/manual with explicit rationale.
findings.actual: check_diagram_quality_gates.py and check_diagram_visual_smoke.py appear only under if:false jobs.
findings.impact: Operators relying on regression plan may assume merge-blocking visual/quality coverage that CI no longer provides.
findings.root_cause: SSOT test plan not rebased after #11196 job disable.
findings.remediation: Edit diagram-regression-test-plan gate frequencies to match docs.yml or add cross-link to #11196 disable notice.

evidence.observation: only inside render-diagrams job behind if: false

findings.method: python -m scripts.diagrams lint docs/02-architecture/diagrams --json; filter STALE-002
findings.observation: 24 diagram sources emit STALE-002 (>90d); cluster includes architecture/24–31 and related families.
findings.expected: Architecture diagrams touched by recent control-plane work carry @date within 90d or explicit review note.
findings.actual: Sample: architecture/24-control-plane-artifact-publication-pipeline.mmd reported 137 days old at audit time.
findings.impact: Readers may treat stale @date as signal of outdated runtime behavior (P2 stale runtime view per audit scale).
findings.root_cause: Content may remain valid but metadata not refreshed after publication pipeline changes.
findings.remediation: Review cluster 24–31 for factual drift; bump @date when verified; run lint-budget before release docs.
findings.automation: lint STALE-002 is Soft; optional nightly lint-budget when re-enabled

findings.method: read validate-mermaid lint_targets logic for pull_request
findings.observation: On PR, lint_diagrams.py runs only on changed *.mmd/*.mermaid paths unless scripts/diagrams or setup-mermaid change triggers full tree.
findings.expected: Either full-corpus lint on main/nightly or documented acceptance that warnings on untouched files are deferred.
findings.actual: Unchanged files with SIZE-002/LINK-001 warnings are not re-linted on typical doc-only PRs.
findings.impact: 100 SIZE-002 and 27 LINK-001 warnings can persist across merges without CI signal.
findings.root_cause: PR cost optimization limits lint scope to diffs.
findings.remediation: Add scheduled full lint report artifact or fail on ERROR-only with published warning budget summary.

findings.observation: 27 sources fail LINK-001 (single arrow semantic style on multi-edge flowcharts); example 09-observability-stack.mmd with 12 edges.
findings.expected: ADR-040 linkStyle differentiation: mix --> / -.-> / ==> semantics on dense flowcharts.
findings.actual: Lint WARNING only; not blocking CI on PR incremental lint.
findings.impact: Layout/style and semantic readability (P3); not deploy-blocking.
findings.root_cause: Legacy diagrams predate LINK-001 enforcement or codemod not applied corpus-wide.
findings.remediation: Run differentiate-linkstyle / harmonize_link_styles codemods on prioritized families.

findings.observation: 100 lint warnings SIZE-002 (@nodes > 20) across corpus; some have decomposed views (SIZE-003) others not.
findings.expected: Large diagrams decomposed per ADR-040 view rules or justified in metadata.
findings.actual: Warnings accumulate; PR lint may not touch unchanged oversized diagrams.
findings.root_cause: Incremental decomposition incomplete for class/architecture families.
findings.remediation: Prioritize views/ splits for top SIZE-002 offenders; track via lint-budget when nightly returns.

findings.method: compare scripts/diagrams/README CI table vs docs.yml active jobs
findings.observation: README states check-quality-gates implements DIAG-T018..T023 regression gates on CI gate (docs.yml + nightly).
findings.expected: Tooling README matches executing workflows after #11196.
findings.actual: check_diagram_quality_gates.py only referenced under disabled render-diagrams and diagram-nightly jobs.
findings.root_cause: README not updated when jobs disabled.
findings.remediation: Add #11196 note to Commands table; point to run_diagram_checks.sh for local gates.

findings.method: grep npm install hints in governance prompt vs canonical README pin
findings.observation: PROMPT-diagram-expansion recommends npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli without @10.6.1 pin.
findings.expected: All render docs reference pinned 10.6.1 and mmdc_wrapper.sh per ADR-040 tooling.
findings.actual: Canonical README pins 10.6.1; expansion prompt still shows unpinned global install.
findings.impact: Local render version drift if contributors follow stale prompt.
findings.root_cause: Governance prompt not synced with mmdc_wrapper MMDC_REQUIRED_VERSION.
findings.remediation: Replace prompt snippet with README rendering section or link to tooling/render.sh.

findings.method: read deprecated workflow header; rg usages
findings.observation: reusable-mermaid-setup.yml marked DEPRECATED KEEP-DISABLED (#10263); no workflow uses workflow_call reference.
findings.expected: Deprecated CI surfaces removed or clearly isolated from operator paths.
findings.actual: File retained for backward compatibility with disabled_manually guard.
findings.impact: Low confusion risk for copy-paste CI templates.
findings.root_cause: Intentional deprecation hold until future PR.
findings.remediation: Delete or archive workflow once grep confirms zero callers (already true).

findings.method: read mmdc_wrapper version gate and setup-mermaid action npm ci
findings.observation: MMDC_REQUIRED_VERSION defaults to 10.6.1 with fail-closed version check; setup-mermaid uses lockfile npm ci and refuses unlocked version overrides.
findings.expected: Pinned reproducible Mermaid CLI per audit anti-pattern (no bare npx -y in CI).
findings.impact: Positive control reducing render drift and supply-chain surprises.
findings.remediation: Keep lockfile refresh process documented in setup-mermaid action comments.

findings.observation: PR job check-diagram-drift re-renders changed diagram sources and enforces git diff --exit-code on sibling SVG bytes.
findings.expected: DIAG-T017 source-render drift gate active on PR when diagram sources change.
findings.actual: Job runs when diagrams_changed and validates expected svg/ updates plus byte identity after render.
findings.impact: Positive control preventing silent SVG baseline drift on touched sources.
findings.remediation: Extend path coverage if new diagram trees added outside glob lists.
